```{r}
process_column <- function(column_name, data_frame) {
  # Rank based on the specified column
  ranked_data <- data_frame %>%
    mutate(Rank = rank(-get(column_name)))
  
  # Smooth the specified column
  smoothed <- loess(get(column_name) ~ Rank, data = ranked_data, span = 0.01, control = loess.control(surface = "direct"))
  ranked_data$Smoothed <- predict(smoothed)
  
  # Calculate first derivative
  ranked_data <- ranked_data %>%
    arrange(desc(Rank)) %>%
    mutate(Deriv1 = c(NA, diff(Smoothed)))
  
  # Smooth the first derivative
  smoothed_deriv1 <- loess(Deriv1 ~ Rank, data = ranked_data, span = 0.1, na.action = na.exclude, control = loess.control(surface = "direct"))
  ranked_data$SmoothedDeriv1 <- predict(smoothed_deriv1, na.action = na.exclude)
  
  return(ranked_data)
}

}
```

```{r}
# Initialize a list to store crossing points for each column
crossing_points_list <- list()

# Iterate through each column's results in results_list
for (col_name in names(results_list)) {
  # Extract the processed data for the column
  processed_data <- results_list[[col_name]]
  
  # Identify the crossing point
  crossing_point <- processed_data %>%
    filter(SmoothedDeriv1 <= 3e-4) %>%
    arrange(Rank) %>%
    slice(1)  # Take the first row if multiple crossings exist
  
  # Extract crossing rank and smoothed value
  crossing_rank <- crossing_point$Rank
  crossing_smoothed_value <- crossing_point$Smoothed
  
  # Store the results in a list
  crossing_points_list[[col_name]] <- data.frame(
    Column = col_name,
    CrossingRank = ifelse(length(crossing_rank) > 0, crossing_rank, NA),
    CrossingSmoothedValue = ifelse(length(crossing_smoothed_value) > 0, crossing_smoothed_value, NA)
  )
}

# Combine all the results into a single data frame
crossing_points_df <- do.call(rbind, crossing_points_list)

# Optionally, remove rows with NA (where no crossing point was found)
crossing_points_df <- na.omit(crossing_points_df)

# Display the combined results

# Convert CrossingRank and CrossingSmoothedValue into numeric if they're not already
crossing_points_df$CrossingRank <- as.numeric(as.character(crossing_points_df$CrossingRank))
crossing_points_df$CrossingSmoothedValue <- as.numeric(as.character(crossing_points_df$CrossingSmoothedValue))

# Merge crossing points with combined_data for plotting
```

```{r}

library(mclust)

chip_mclust_icl <- function(data, column_name, G_range = 1:5, tail_cutoff = NULL) {
  # Ensure the column exists in the dataframe
  if (!column_name %in% names(data)) {
    stop("Column name does not exist in the dataframe")
  }

  # Extract the column for clustering
  column_data <- data[[column_name]]

  # Initialize a vector to store final classifications, defaulting to 0 (pruned)
  final_classification <- rep(0, length(column_data))

  # Identify data points above the tail_cutoff
  if (!is.null(tail_cutoff)) {
    above_cutoff <- column_data > tail_cutoff
    column_data <- column_data[!above_cutoff]
  } else {
    above_cutoff <- rep(FALSE, length(column_data))  # No data is pruned
  }

  # Ensure column_data is a dataframe expected by Mclust
  column_data_df <- data.frame(column_data = column_data)

  # Perform initial clustering with a range of G values to determine best model
  initial_mclust <- Mclust(column_data_df, G = G_range)
  
  # Use mclustICL to find the best model based on ICL
  icl_test <- mclustICL(column_data_df, G = G_range)
  
  # Find the index of the highest ICL value
  best_model_index <- which.max(icl_test)
  best_g <- attr(icl_test, "G")[best_model_index]
  best_model_type <- attr(icl_test, "modelNames")[ceiling(best_model_index / length(best_g))]
  
  # Re-fit Mclust with the best G and model type
  best_mclust_model <- Mclust(column_data_df, G = best_g, model = best_model_type)
  
  # Update final_classification with classifications for non-pruned data
  final_classification[!above_cutoff] <- best_mclust_model$classification

  # Return classification (including pruned data as a separate group) and the best model summary
  return(list(
    classification = final_classification,
    best_model_summary = summary(best_mclust_model)
  ))
}
```

```{r}
chip_mclust_icl_all <- function(data, G_range = 1:5, tail_cutoff = NULL) {
  results <- list()  # Initialize an empty list to store results
  
  # Iterate through each column in the dataframe
  for (column_name in names(data)) {
    # Apply tail_cutoff if specified
    if (!is.null(tail_cutoff)) {
      data_to_process <- data[[column_name]][data[[column_name]] <= tail_cutoff]
    } else {
      data_to_process <- data[[column_name]]
    }
    
    # Check if data_to_process is not empty
    if(length(data_to_process) > 0) {
      # Ensure data is in the correct format for Mclust
      mclust_data <- data.frame(column_data = data_to_process)
  
      # Perform ICL to determine the best model
      icl_results <- mclustICL(mclust_data, G = G_range)
      
      # Find the best model based on ICL
      best_icl_value <- max(icl_results)
      best_model_info <- which(icl_results == best_icl_value, arr.ind = TRUE)
      best_g <- best_model_info[1]
      best_model <- names(icl_results)[best_model_info[2]]
      
      # Re-run Mclust with the best parameters
      best_mclust_model <- Mclust(mclust_data, G = best_g, model = best_model)
      
      # Store classification results
      results[[column_name]] <- best_mclust_model$classification
    } else {
      results[[column_name]] <- NA  # Assign NA if data was pruned away completely
    }
  }
  
  return(results)
}

histone_rlog_prune_mean_only$cluster <- NULL
results_all <- chip_mclust_icl_all(histone_rlog_prune_mean_only)
```

```{r, fig.width= 5, fig.height= 5}
library(tidyr)

# Assuming results_all contains both the data and their classifications
# Reshape results_all to long format correctly

results_all$gene_id <- row.names(results_all)
tail_remove_class <-  as_tibble(results_all)

data_long <- results_all %>%
  dplyr::select(-ends_with("_class"), gene_id) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = -gene_id,
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "value"
  )

# Convert the classification data to long format
class_long <- tail_remove_class %>%
  dplyr::select(ends_with("_class"), gene_id) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -gene_id,
    names_to = "variable_class",
    values_to = "group"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(variable = gsub("_class$", "", variable_class)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-variable_class)

# Merge data and classification
merged_data <- left_join(data_long, class_long, by = c("gene_id", "variable"))

# Generate the plot

n <- nrow(merged_data) / length(unique(merged_data$variable))

  geom_histogram(aes(fill = factor(group), colour =  factor(group)), bins = 50, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_density(aes(colour = factor(group), y = ..count../sum(..count..)), alpha = 0.3) +
  facet_wrap(~variable) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(fill = "Group", colour = "Group")
```

```{r, fig.width= 5, fig.height= 5}
clusterEvalQ(cl, list(library(mclust), library(mixtools), library(ggplot2)))

histone_rlog_prune_mclust <- parLapply(cl, histone_rlog_prune_mean_l, call_mclust)
histone_rlog_prune_bin <- parLapply(cl, histone_rlog_prune_mean_l, call_mix_bin)

stopCluster(cl)

histone_rlog_prune_mclust_m <- dplyr::bind_rows(histone_rlog_prune_mclust)  
histone_rlog_prune_bin_m <- dplyr::bind_rows(histone_rlog_prune_bin)  

hist_breaks <- seq(0, 1, by = 0.02)
n <- dim(histone_rlog_prune_mean)[1]


ggplot(histone_rlog_prune_mclust_m, aes(value)) + 
  #geom_histogram(aes(y = ..count..), bins = 50, alpha = 0.5, position="identity" ) #+ 
  geom_histogram(aes(y = ..count..), colour = "black", fill = "grey", breaks = hist_breaks, alpha = 0.8) +
  #geom_density(data = h3k27me3, aes(colour = factor(h3k27me3_group), fill = factor(h3k27me3_group)), alpha = 0.3) 
  geom_density(aes(y =..density..*(n * 0.02),colour = factor(group), fill = factor(group)), alpha = 0.3)  + 
  facet_wrap(~variable)


ggplot(histone_rlog_prune_bin_m, aes(value)) + 
  #geom_histogram(aes(y = ..count..), bins = 50, alpha = 0.5, position="identity" ) #+ 
  geom_histogram(aes(y = ..count..), colour = "black", fill = "grey", breaks = hist_breaks, alpha = 0.8) +
  #geom_density(data = h3k27me3, aes(colour = factor(h3k27me3_group), fill = factor(h3k27me3_group)), alpha = 0.3) 
  geom_density(aes(y =..density..*(n * 0.02),colour = factor(group), fill = factor(group)), alpha = 0.3)  + 
  facet_wrap(~variable) + 
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", 
          legend.direction = "horizontal",
          legend.box.just	= "top",
          legend.box = "horizontal", 
          panel.spacing = unit(2, "lines"))


histone_mclust <- histone_rlog_prune_mclust_m %>%
  dplyr::select(-value) %>%
  tidyr::spread(key = variable, value = group )

histone_bin <- histone_rlog_prune_bin_m %>%
  dplyr::select(-value) %>%
  tidyr::spread(key = variable, value = group )
```
